synthesis.appearance_hypotheses: Repeated model-generated captions included a clock with a blue background and a clock face (3 frames); a colorful cube with a black background (3 frames); a black and white image of a spiral (3 frames). Frequent prompt-relative hypotheses: light: neon lighting (16/32 frames); material: smooth digital surfaces (16/32 frames); medium: a graphic poster (22/32 frames); setting: an abstract composition (29/32 frames); tone: a tense ominous image (31/32 frames).
synthesis.audio_control: 16 matched programme-versus-silence comparisons had median hue divergence 0.002 bits. Differences may also reflect unseeded projectM rendering or feedback evolution, not just musical response.

synthesis.interpretation_limits: PixelCue features quantify sampled rasters, not subjective quality or creative intention. BLIP captions, CLIP prompts and VLM tags are fallible per-frame hypotheses. Still frames cannot establish flash safety or perceived motion quality. Only an authenticated artist-provided suite can establish behaviour on actual album audio.
synthesis.observed_effects: Across input families, colour-bars: hue divergence median 0.071 bits, texture divergence median 0.337 bits across 8 observed pairs; cover-lyrics: hue divergence median 0.070 bits, texture divergence median 0.395 bits across 8 observed pairs; grid-rings: hue divergence median 0.005 bits, texture divergence median 0.134 bits across 8 observed pairs; text-card: hue divergence median unavailable bits, texture divergence median 0.339 bits across 8 observed pairs.
synthesis.scope: Observed 32 paired source/output measurements across 8 declared conditions, including 2 cover/lyric conditions and output times 0, 0.5, 1.5, 3 seconds.
synthesis.temporal_behaviour: For successive captures of the same input condition, median measured texture divergence was 0.020 bits across 24 transitions.
